project_type: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite frontend with AWS Lambda (Python 3.13) backend
build_system: pnpm for frontend, pytest for backend. NODE_OPTIONS must be unset before running node/pnpm commands.
test_command: unset NODE_OPTIONS && cd /projects/sandbox/hanashite-tsukurun && npx vitest --run --exclude e2e/**
verification_instructions: 1. Run TypeScript type-check: unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx tsc -b --noEmit. 2. Run vitest: unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest --run --exclude e2e/**. 3. Run lambda tests: cd lambda && python -m pytest -q (note: 9 pre-existing failures in test_handler.py due to rate_limiter mock issue).
setup_instructions: 1. unset NODE_OPTIONS. 2. cd /projects/sandbox/hanashite-tsukurun && pnpm install. 3. pyenv global 3.13.13 && pip install hypothesis pytest boto3.
environment_constraints: NODE_OPTIONS env var breaks node - must be unset. Python via pyenv global 3.13.13. e2e tests (@playwright) cannot run (no playwright installed). 9 pre-existing lambda test failures related to rate_limiter mocking - do not fix those.
contribution_requirements: Glassmorphism design pattern (frosted glass with backdrop-filter, semi-transparent backgrounds, white text on gradient backgrounds). Child-friendly UI. All text must use STEP_GUIDE_MESSAGES and QUESTION_RATIONALE_MESSAGES constants exactly as defined in design.md. VITE_MOCK_MODE must work without AWS.
key_patterns: Components use inline styles (React.CSSProperties objects), not CSS modules. Colors are white on gradient backgrounds. Components export named functions. Tests use @testing-library/react. Hooks in src/hooks/. Types in src/types/index.ts. Mock responses in src/mocks/mockResponses.ts. Lambda modules flat in lambda/ directory.
directory_structure: src/components/{GradeSelector,MainScreen,SlidePreview,FinishScreen}/ - React components. src/hooks/ - custom hooks. src/services/ - API client. src/mocks/ - mock data. src/types/ - shared types. lambda/ - Python Lambda code with flat structure. specs/hanashite-tsukurun/ - requirements.md and design.md.
